proof:
Source: Simon Ch. 5, proof of Lemma 2.6, inequalities (9)-(10) (step 7 of the parent proof), with corrections (i) Lambda = 4p delta/(p-n) and (v) the annulus is B_(3s) minus B_s and the ball B_(3s)(zeta) is controlled by the pinched bounds at a nearby support point.

Constants. kappa := (p-n)/(4p), omega_n := unitBallVolume n, delta_P from the pinched-density child (lip_approx_pinched_density), A_8 := 72 * 3^n e^2/omega_n, and
 eps := (4 A_8 omega_n 5^n)^(-1/2) > 0, C_0 := 2 A_8 > 0, delta_0 := min{delta_P, kappa, 3^-n omega_n (p-n)/(32 e p)} > 0.
Let 0 < delta <= delta_0, 2.3 hold, sigma_0 := delta rho, T a subspace, P := p_T, Q := I - P, F closed with |Q(x - z)| <= eps |x - z| for x, z in F, zeta in F with |zeta| <= 17 sigma_0/32 and 0 < d := infDist(zeta, spt V) <= sigma_0/16; put s := d/2, mu := V.weight, tau(x) := hsNormSq(p_x - P), tilt(A) := integral_A tau dmu, Lambda := 4p delta/(p-n) (<= 1 since delta <= kappa).
1. Nearest support point. spt mu is closed and contains spt V, which contains 0, so there is y in spt mu with |y - zeta| = infDist(zeta, spt mu) <= infDist(zeta, spt V) = d. Then |y| <= 17 sigma_0/32 + sigma_0/16 = 19 sigma_0/32 < rho, so y lies in B_rho(0), contained in U, hence y in spt V = U cap spt mu, so |y - zeta| >= d. Thus |y - zeta| = d = 2s and infDist(zeta, spt mu) = d. The open ball B^o_d(zeta) does not meet spt mu, so mu(B^o_d(zeta)) = 0 (the complement of spt mu is mu-null), and since s < d, mu(B_s(zeta)) = 0.
2. Monotonicity at zeta. Put R := (1 - 3 delta) rho >= 5 rho/8. Since |zeta| <= 17 sigma_0/32 <= 3 delta rho, B_R(zeta) is contained in B_rho(0); and 0 < s <= 3s <= 3 sigma_0/32 < R. The second assertion of the monotonicity child (lip_approx_monotonicity; centre zeta, r := 3s) together with mu(B_s(zeta)) = 0 gives
 (3s)^-n mu(B_(3s)(zeta)) <= 2 e^Lambda Lambda + e^(2 Lambda) integral_(B_(3s)(zeta) minus B_s(zeta)) |p_x^perp(x - zeta)|^2 |x - zeta|^(-n-2) dmu <= 2 e Lambda + e^2 s^(-n-2) I,
 where I := integral_(B_(3s)(zeta)) |p_x^perp(x - zeta)|^2 dmu: on the annulus |x - zeta| > s, and the integrand of I is nonnegative, bounded by 9 s^2, and mu-measurable (tangent-structure child lip_approx_tangent_structure), while mu(B_(3s)(zeta)) < infinity.
3. Lower bound. B_s(y) is contained in B_(3s)(zeta) (|y - zeta| = 2s). By the pinched-density child (y in spt V, |y| <= 19 sigma_0/32 <= 3 delta rho, s <= rho/2), mu(B_s(y)) >= omega_n s^n/2, so 3^-n omega_n/2 <= (3s)^-n mu(B_(3s)(zeta)) <= 2 e Lambda + e^2 s^(-n-2) I. Because delta <= 3^-n omega_n (p-n)/(32 e p), 2 e Lambda = 8 e p delta/(p-n) <= 3^-n omega_n/4, hence s^(n+2) <= 4 * 3^n e^2 omega_n^-1 I.
4. Upper bound for I. For every x, p_x^perp = Q + (P - p_x), so |p_x^perp(x - zeta)|^2 <= 2 |Q(x - zeta)|^2 + 2 |P - p_x|^2 |x - zeta|^2 <= 2 |Q(x - zeta)|^2 + 18 s^2 tau(x) on B_(3s)(zeta) (operator norm <= Hilbert-Schmidt norm). For x in F cap B_(3s)(zeta), |Q(x - zeta)| <= eps |x - zeta| <= 3 eps s (zeta in F); for every x in B_(3s)(zeta), |Q(x - zeta)| <= |x - zeta| <= 3s. Moreover B_(3s)(zeta) is contained in B_(5s)(y), so mu(B_(3s)(zeta)) <= mu(B_(5s)(y)) <= 2 omega_n 5^n s^n by the pinched-density child (|y| <= 3 delta rho, 5s <= rho/2). F is closed, so B_(3s)(zeta) splits into the measurable parts B_(3s)(zeta) cap F and B_(3s)(zeta) minus F, and tau is integrable on B_(3s)(zeta) (tangent-structure child). Therefore
 I <= 18 eps^2 s^2 mu(B_(3s)(zeta)) + 18 s^2 mu(B_(3s)(zeta) minus F) + 18 s^2 tilt(B_(3s)(zeta)) <= 18 s^2 [2 omega_n 5^n eps^2 s^n + mu(B_(3s)(zeta) minus F) + tilt(B_(3s)(zeta))].
5. Conclusion. By steps 3 and 4, s^n <= A_8 [2 omega_n 5^n eps^2 s^n + mu(B_(3s)(zeta) minus F) + tilt(B_(3s)(zeta))]. Since A_8 * 2 omega_n 5^n eps^2 = 1/2, s^n <= 2 A_8 [mu(B_(3s)(zeta) minus F) + tilt(B_(3s)(zeta))] = C_0 [...], which, written in [0, infinity] with tilt >= 0, is ofReal(s^n) <= ofReal(C_0) (V.weight(B_(3s)(zeta) minus F) + ofReal(tilt(B_(3s)(zeta)))).
key_steps: Nearest point y of spt mu to zeta lies in spt V at distance exactly d = 2s, so mu(B_s(zeta)) = 0

B_s(y) inside B_(3s)(zeta) and the pinched lower bound at y, with 2e Lambda <= 3^-n omega_n/4, give s^(n+2) <= 4 3^n e^2 omega_n^-1 I
p_x^perp = Q + (P - p_x), the cone property on F and the pinched upper bound bound I by 18 s^2 [2 omega_n 5^n eps^2 s^n + mu(B_(3s) minus F) + tilt]
eps^2 = 1/(4 A_8 omega_n 5^n) absorbs the first term: s^n <= 2 A_8 [mu(B_(3s)(zeta) minus F) + tilt(B_(3s)(zeta))]
